result.what_to_change: Error toasts should use an assertive live region (e.g. role="alert"/aria-live="assertive") separate from the polite status region used for info/success, and the auto-dismiss timeout in the Toast component should be skipped (or made much longer) for items with kind === "error" so they persist until manually dismissed.

input.title: Make error toasts assertive and persistent until dismissed
input.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Error toasts currently share a single role="status" aria-live="polite" container with info/success toasts and are auto-dismissed after 5000ms like any other toast. Add a separate assertive live region (role="alert"/aria-live="assertive") for error toasts, and skip or greatly extend the auto-dismiss timeout for items with kind === "error" so they persist until manually dismissed.
